description: INMASPOL examines reinforced-concrete frames with masonry infills joined or strengthened using deformable polyurethane systems. Full-scale shaking tests assess in-plane and out-of-plane response of modified, repaired and strengthened configurations. The observations support evaluation of flexible-joint and fibre-reinforced-polyurethane representations; reported performance applies to the tested arrangements. The dataset is provided by IZIIS, Skopje through BED. BED assigns the experiment to 2019. The provider metadata identifies compressed archives. BED displays download links with no stated charge. Actual file retrieval was not tested. The stated licence is CC BY 4.0. The measurements support calibration or checking of infrastructure response models.
